narr: Monsoon moisture over northern Arizona triggered thunderstorms that caused flash flooding.
ev: Indian Route 15 was closed due to flooding at mile post 95 between Cornfields and Greasewood. Report was from Navajo Nation Road Conditions Facebook page.
